loop_policy.blocked_dependency_rule: Unresolved child work blocks the parent exit; independent units can continue.
loop_policy.sibling_completion_rule: Evidence covers only the named unit, gate and round.

game.profile_intensity_boundary: Project type selects domain gate standards and default artifacts; profile intensity remains orthogonal and only adjusts governance depth such as evidence volume, reviewer strictness, and interruption budget.

quality_budget.playability_smoke: Each playable slice has deterministic launch, core loop, save/load or retry path, and regression smoke evidence.
quality_budget.performance_budget: Scene/frame pacing budget is stated per target platform and checked before release candidate.
quality_budget.asset_budget: New art/audio/data assets list source, license, size/performance impact, and fallback behavior.
quality_budget.narrative_continuity: Chapter or level changes preserve story continuity, state transitions, and prior released content.

release_checks: playable build launches from a clean checkout
asset manifest and licensing facts are recorded
save/load or retry path is verified when relevant
known defects and rollback path are documented

gate_policy.stage_skip_requires: Skip or merge only when the chapter/level/asset has explicit acceptance evidence and no upstream dependency blocker.
gate_policy.blocked_dependency_rule: A blocked chapter, level, asset, or engine-system blocks only declared downstream dependents.
gate_policy.sibling_completion_rule: Passing one chapter or level does not imply sibling chapters, levels, assets, or systems have passed.

web-app.profile_intensity_boundary: Project type selects domain gate standards and default artifacts; profile intensity remains orthogonal and only adjusts governance depth such as evidence volume, reviewer strictness, and interruption budget.

quality_budget.accessibility: Keyboard, focus, contrast, labels, and responsive layout evidence are required for user-facing slices.
quality_budget.security: Auth, input validation, secret handling, and dependency risk are checked for changed surfaces.
quality_budget.performance: Critical page or API latency budgets are stated and smoke-tested before release.
quality_budget.reliability: Error states, loading states, and rollback or feature flag behavior are documented.

release_checks: rollback or feature flag path exists

gate_policy.stage_skip_requires: Skip only for small vertical slices with existing architecture and unchanged risk profile.
gate_policy.blocked_dependency_rule: A blocked story blocks only declared downstream stories/modules/release candidates.
gate_policy.sibling_completion_rule: Passing one story does not imply adjacent screens, APIs, or modules have passed.

mobile-app.profile_intensity_boundary: Project type selects domain gate standards and default artifacts; profile intensity remains orthogonal and only adjusts governance depth such as evidence volume, reviewer strictness, and interruption budget.

quality_budget.device_matrix: Representative device/OS matrix and emulator or physical-device evidence are recorded.
quality_budget.offline_behavior: Offline, reconnect, permissions, and storage behavior are validated where touched.
quality_budget.store_readiness: Store metadata, privacy, signing, and release channel checks are explicit before release.
quality_budget.performance: Startup, memory, and interaction latency budgets are checked for affected screens.

gate_policy.stage_skip_requires: Skip only for isolated screens/stories with unchanged platform permissions and release channel.
gate_policy.blocked_dependency_rule: A blocked screen/story blocks only declared downstream screens/stories/release candidates.
gate_policy.sibling_completion_rule: Passing one platform or screen does not imply other platforms or screens have passed.

library.profile_intensity_boundary: Project type selects domain gate standards and default artifacts; profile intensity remains orthogonal and only adjusts governance depth such as evidence volume, reviewer strictness, and interruption budget.

quality_budget.api_stability: Public API changes identify compatibility impact and migration notes when needed.
quality_budget.semver_discipline: Version bump rationale maps to breaking, feature, fix, or docs-only impact.
quality_budget.docs_examples: Public API docs and executable examples are updated with changed behavior.
quality_budget.downstream_confidence: At least one downstream fixture, consumer test, or compatibility rationale exists for public changes.

release_checks: unit and public API tests pass
downstream tests or compatibility rationale pass

gate_policy.stage_skip_requires: Skip only for internal-only changes or documented public API no-op changes.
gate_policy.blocked_dependency_rule: A blocked API surface blocks dependent modules, releases, and downstream fixtures only when declared.
gate_policy.sibling_completion_rule: Passing one module does not imply all public APIs or downstream consumers have passed.

cli-tool.profile_intensity_boundary: Project type selects domain gate standards and default artifacts; profile intensity remains orthogonal and only adjusts governance depth such as evidence volume, reviewer strictness, and interruption budget.

quality_budget.command_contract: Command syntax, stdout/stderr, exit codes, and config/env behavior are stable and tested.
quality_budget.error_diagnostics: Common failure modes produce actionable diagnostics without hiding non-zero failures.
quality_budget.idempotency: Repeated runs, dry-run mode, and partial failure behavior are documented when applicable.
quality_budget.packaging: Install, upgrade, and shell/platform expectations are checked before release.

gate_policy.stage_skip_requires: Skip only for non-user-visible command internals with unchanged command contract.
gate_policy.blocked_dependency_rule: A blocked command blocks declared dependent commands/modules/release candidates only.
gate_policy.sibling_completion_rule: Passing one command does not imply all commands or shells have passed.

ai-agent-plugin.profile_intensity_boundary: Project type selects domain gate standards and default artifacts; profile intensity remains orthogonal and only adjusts governance depth such as evidence volume, reviewer strictness, and interruption budget.

quality_budget.runtime_truthfulness: Adapter/runtime matrices distinguish PASS, BLOCKED, DEGRADED, and NOT_RUNTIME_VERIFIED.
quality_budget.projection_sync: Source, target fixture, manifests, hooks, and native entries stay synchronized.
quality_budget.no_overclaim: Docs and release notes do not claim unavailable approvals, marketplace status, universal support, risk closure, or 1.0.0 readiness.
quality_budget.host_capability: Host skill/plugin/tool/MCP/browser/sub-agent availability is discovered and degraded explicitly.

gate_policy.stage_skip_requires: Skip only when adapter surface and host capability are unchanged and existing runtime evidence remains current.
gate_policy.blocked_dependency_rule: A blocked adapter/skill/manifest blocks only declared downstream adapters, docs, and releases.
gate_policy.sibling_completion_rule: Passing one host adapter does not imply other host adapters have passed.

internal-script.profile_intensity_boundary: Project type selects domain gate standards and default artifacts; profile intensity remains orthogonal and only adjusts governance depth such as evidence volume, reviewer strictness, and interruption budget.

quality_budget.dry_run: Scripts with side effects expose dry-run or equivalent preview unless explicitly impossible.
quality_budget.rollback: Rollback, restore, or no-op recovery behavior is stated for destructive or external effects.
quality_budget.idempotency: Repeated execution behavior and partial failure handling are documented.
quality_budget.scope_control: Target path, environment, and side-effect boundaries are explicit.

gate_policy.stage_skip_requires: Skip only for local/internal scripts with bounded side effects and explicit operator acceptance.
gate_policy.blocked_dependency_rule: A blocked script/job blocks only declared downstream jobs or automation chains.
gate_policy.sibling_completion_rule: Passing one script does not imply sibling jobs or environments have passed.

gate_execution_registry.notes: Checks enumerate the evidence expected from the domain activity. The loop command chooses the applicable gate, verifies the independently reviewed round, and applies the result to its work unit.
